gaps: High-quality animated storytelling for regional folk traditions (like Adhaiya Leela) integrated with major Puranic deities.
Narrative explanations of the symbolic 'why' behind specific festival rituals (e.g., Chaumukhi Deepak on Bhai Dooj) woven into dramatic kathas rather than dry ritual guides.
Full-length uninterrupted animated mythological movies narrated entirely in emotional Hindi without English clickbait titles.
saturated: Generic day-by-day Navratri Mata Kathas (Maa Siddhidatri, Maa Katyayani) without unique narrative hooks or emotional angles.
Static photo slideshows set to Janmashtami bhajans and audio songs.
Dry temple history videos (e.g., Tirupati Balaji facts) lacking story-driven devotional drama.
